sources.title: Swain Build Guide: [ NEW SEASON UPDATED!! ] - SWAIN is the GOD OF MIDLANE PAIN!

passive.name: Ravenous Flock
passive.text: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

spells.name: Death's Hand
spells.text: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

spells.name: Vision of Empire
spells.text: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

spells.name: Nevermove
spells.text: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

spells.name: Demonic Ascension
spells.text: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

archetype.value: Swain is a versatile champion who can build for full damage or play as an off-tank.

winCondition.value: Swain thrives in team fights in tight areas, where Demonic Ascension deals area damage and Nevermove can root multiple targets.

spikes.why: Swain gains stronger lane sustain with Demonic Ascension.
Swain can survive more reliably in mid- and late-game team fights.
Swain can unleash Death's Hand more often than at its 7-second cooldown.

mistakes.value: Swain risks his life by face-checking bushes instead of scouting them with Vision of Empire.
Swain loses potential damage by reactivating Demonic Ascension too early.
Swain cannot keep Demonic Ascension active indefinitely without draining enemy champions.
